meta.name: refactoring-patterns
meta.description: Apply named refactoring transformations to improve code structure without changing behavior. Use when the user mentions "refactor this", "code smells", "extract method", "replace conditional", "technical debt", "move method", "inline variable", "decompose conditional", or "clean up this messy code". Also trigger when cleaning up legacy code, preparing code for new features by restructuring, or identifying which transformation fits a specific code smell. Covers smell-driven refactoring, safe transformation sequences, and testing guards. For code-quality foundations, see clean-code. For managing complexity, see software-design-philosophy.

copy.tagline: 应用重构变换改善代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要重构代码、消除技术债务
copy.tagline_en: Apply refactoring transformations to improve code structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to refactor code and eliminate technical debt

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用命名好的重构手法（如提取方法、移动字段）改善代码结构，但不改变代码行为。它会先检查测试是否通过，然后一步步做小改动，每步都再跑测试确保没破坏功能。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构这段代码”、“代码坏味”、“提取方法”、“替换条件”等关键词，或者要求清理遗留代码、为新增功能重组代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个函数，它太长了。
say.note: Claude 会分析函数并建议提取方法等重构。

say.text: 这段代码有重复逻辑，怎么消除？
say.note: Claude 会识别重复并建议提取方法或上移方法。

say.text: 这个类有上帝类坏味，怎么拆分？
say.note: Claude 会建议提取类或移动字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you improve code structure using named refactoring patterns (e.g., Extract Method, Move Field) without changing behavior. It verifies tests pass, applies one small transformation, and re-runs tests to ensure nothing breaks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "refactor this", "code smells", "extract method", "replace conditional", or similar keywords, or when you ask to clean up legacy code or restructure for new features.

say_en.text: Refactor this function, it's too long.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest Extract Method.

say_en.text: This code has duplicate logic, how to eliminate it?
say_en.note: Claude will identify duplication and suggest Extract Method or Pull Up Method.

say_en.text: This class has a God class smell, how to split it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest Extract Class or Move Field.
